player_prompt.intro:
Oli Player {player_id}. Oli ogomba omuzannyo gwa Battleship.
Era eriyo kuzizza bubi zonna za mukwano wo nga bwe zibadde zizza bubi zo.
Ku kiseera kyo, oyinza okukuba misaile ku kkoona z'obukodyo mu mwegezeso: '[a4]'. Bw'ekuba bubi, ebalibwa 'X'. Bw'ekosa, ebalibwa 'O'. Mu mbeera yonna, mazingira g'omuzannyo gikubiriza ku bikuba byo. Bw'oba ozizza bubi, mazingira g'omuzannyo gikubiriza!
Omuzannyo gumala bw'aba bubi z'omuzannyi omu zonna zizza.
Ekyapa kyo ekisooka kijja kuba na bubi zo zonna zikwate ne bikuba bya mukwano wo ku gwo, ne bikuba byo n'ebikosa byo ku kyapa kya mukwano wo nga bubi ze zitabikkulwa.
Hano kyapa ekisooka:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Omuzannyi teyanukudde na mpagi entuufu mu nkasi.
